verdict.rationale: Navan documents an official REST API (OAuth2 client-credentials, expense/card/travel endpoints, webhooks) and an MCP server for AI assistants, which developers can build against, but there is no evidence of language-specific official SDKs (e.g., Python/JS client libraries) — only raw API/MCP documentation. missing for 10: explicit SDK packages/libraries, code samples in multiple languages, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
